selected_topics.lesson_subject: Software-switch 802.1X, MAB, dynamic VLANs and RADIUS group-address objects
selected_topics.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: software-switch port authentication -> RADIUS Fortinet-Group-Name -> dynamic 8021x address object -> firewall policy
selected_topics.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: EAP or MAB Access-Request; RADIUS Access-Accept and group/VLAN authorization; MAC/interface/VLAN bound to dynamic address; firewall policy match
selected_topics.failure_class: RADIUS succeeds but dynamic address binding or intra-switch policy enforcement is missing
selected_topics.evidence_pattern: diagnose sys 802-1x-addr dump shows authenticated MAC/interface/VLAN; policy/session evidence remains separate
selected_topics.remediation_path: set intra-switch-policy explicit; align Fortinet-Group-Name with dynamic address name; verify VLAN, policy order and session
selected_topics.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: endpoint -> software switch -> 802.1X/MAB -> RADIUS -> dynamic address/policy

selected_topics.lesson_subject: Per-device FortiSwitch template overrides: shared baseline, port exceptions and revert scope
selected_topics.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: shared FortiSwitch template -> device override layer -> selected port deviation -> scoped revert
selected_topics.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: create template; assign device; Configure Override; enable; edit port cell; save; port-level Revert All or device-level disable
selected_topics.failure_class: one switch port diverges from peers while sharing the same template
selected_topics.evidence_pattern: edited-cell tooltip and Template-column marker show stored override; target config/install preview prove deployment intent
selected_topics.remediation_path: inspect override before editing baseline; use port-level Revert All for one port; disable override only for whole-device reset
selected_topics.question_fingerprint: override semantics and port-level versus device-level revert
selected_topics.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: template baseline -> assigned switch -> override layer -> selected port -> target install

selected_topics.lesson_subject: Custom administrator session labels: changeable versus unique-per-session audit context
selected_topics.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: admin login -> mandatory session label -> session mode -> actions tagged -> Event Log Custom Session ID
selected_topics.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: enable custom-session-label; choose changeable or unique-per-session; enter <=36-char label at login; tag admin events
selected_topics.failure_class: admin actions cannot be grouped reliably into a change or incident window
selected_topics.evidence_pattern: Current Session List shows active label; Event Logs Custom Session ID column associates completed actions
selected_topics.remediation_path: enable feature; standardize ticket-style labels; correlate label with username/time/session identifiers
selected_topics.question_fingerprint: immutable per-session label versus global uniqueness; audit evidence boundary
selected_topics.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: administrator login -> label prompt -> active session -> actions -> Event Log

selected_topics.lesson_subject: OSPF on routed VLAN interfaces: reference bandwidth, cost consistency and network-type election
selected_topics.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: RVI -> OSPF network type -> adjacency/DR election -> reference bandwidth cost -> route preference
selected_topics.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: select broadcast/p2p/p2mp; form adjacency; compute cost from reference bandwidth/interface bandwidth; install route
selected_topics.failure_class: unexpected DR/BDR behavior or inconsistent path cost across OSPF domain
selected_topics.evidence_pattern: neighbor state and route/cost evidence; same reference bandwidth verified on all routers
selected_topics.remediation_path: match network type to actual segment; align reference bandwidth domain-wide; validate adjacency and route cost separately
selected_topics.question_fingerprint: network type election behavior and common reference bandwidth
selected_topics.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: RVI -> OSPF interface type -> adjacency -> cost formula -> route selection

selected_topics.lesson_subject: FortiAP Layer 3 ACLs with FQDN and wildcard source/destination matching
selected_topics.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: wireless client -> AP L3 Firewall Profile -> FQDN/wildcard match -> IPv4/IPv6 ACL -> allow/deny
selected_topics.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: enable Advanced Wireless Features; configure FQDN source/destination in AP L3 profile; order specific/wildcard rules; test family/path
selected_topics.failure_class: wireless allow/deny differs because FQDN rule type, wildcard order or address family is wrong
selected_topics.evidence_pattern: effective AP profile and controlled hostname allow/block tests
selected_topics.remediation_path: enable feature visibility; configure AP profile; place specific match before broad wildcard; test IPv4 and IPv6
selected_topics.question_fingerprint: AP-local enforcement point, wildcard precedence and DNS/address-family validation
selected_topics.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: wireless client -> AP profile -> FQDN matcher -> IPv4/IPv6 rule -> decision

selected_topics.lesson_subject: Local RADIUS authentication versus proxy mode: EAP methods, MAC auth and accounting boundary
selected_topics.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: NAS Access-Request -> FortiNAC local/proxy RADIUS -> EAP/MAC decision -> Access-Accept/Reject; accounting separate
selected_topics.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: enable Local RADIUS; select EAP/MAC method; allocate distinct authentication ports if proxy also enabled; optionally proxy accounting
selected_topics.failure_class: local authentication works but accounting is absent or requests reach wrong listener
selected_topics.evidence_pattern: Access-Accept/Reject verifies authentication; external RADIUS accounting receipt verifies accounting proxy
selected_topics.remediation_path: separate authentication ports; configure accounting proxy when required; inspect actual local/proxy request path
selected_topics.question_fingerprint: Local RADIUS EAP/MAC capability and accounting separation
selected_topics.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: NAS -> FortiNAC local RADIUS -> EAP/MAC decision -> response; accounting -> external RADIUS

selected_topics.lesson_subject: CentOS FortiNAC to FortiNAC-OS migration: topology selection, entitlement transfer and port hardening
selected_topics.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: legacy CentOS topology -> registration/licensing -> new NAC-OS -> data transfer -> cutover -> restricted services
selected_topics.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: choose topology-specific guide; register appliance; transfer perpetual entitlements or acquire new subscription license; collect/transfer data; cut over; enable required ports
selected_topics.failure_class: cutover succeeds but licensing, Manager synchronization or required services are missing
selected_topics.evidence_pattern: appliance identity, endpoint entitlements, Manager/C+A sync, interface allowaccess and integration checks
selected_topics.remediation_path: use correct single CA/separate C+A/Manager/HA guide; verify migration-tool version and entitlement type; open only required ports
selected_topics.question_fingerprint: topology-specific migration and license transfer boundary
selected_topics.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: CentOS CA/Manager -> preflight/license -> new NAC-OS -> migration transfer -> cutover

selected_topics.lesson_subject: FSSO filtering of Windows AD computer accounts: object lookup, not suffix-only filtering
selected_topics.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: Windows logon -> account ending $ -> AD object lookup -> computer filtered/user published -> FSSO mapping
selected_topics.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: FSSO method receives logon; FAC looks up AD object; computer account excluded; user account continues to FortiGate
selected_topics.failure_class: computer identity is published as user or valid users disappear after filtering
selected_topics.evidence_pattern: known computer object absent from FSSO feed while known human user remains mapped
selected_topics.remediation_path: enable option on active method; validate AD lookup connectivity and test paired computer/user objects
selected_topics.question_fingerprint: AD object classification versus suffix-only filter
selected_topics.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: Windows logon -> FortiAuthenticator -> AD lookup -> FSSO feed -> FortiGate

selected_topics.lesson_subject: FortiPAM configuration backup/restore: encrypted credentials, omitted logs and cross-platform migration boundary
selected_topics.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: configuration backup -> encrypted credential state -> key precondition -> restore -> credential/target validation; logs/videos separate
selected_topics.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: backup in maintenance mode; preserve private-data-encryption key; restore key before config; validate secrets and targets; retrieve logs/videos separately
selected_topics.failure_class: restore completes but encrypted credentials, rotated passwords, audit logs or videos are missing
selected_topics.evidence_pattern: backup version/time, encryption-key acceptance, config-error log, restored target access and separate log/video stores
selected_topics.remediation_path: backup in maintenance mode; restore same private-data key first; do not assume cross-platform portability; export audit/video data separately
selected_topics.question_fingerprint: backup content boundary, key ordering and unsupported platform migration
selected_topics.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: FortiPAM config -> encrypted backup -> key precondition -> restore -> validation; logs/videos separate

selected_topics.lesson_subject: Windows Agent native XML transfer: Collector parsing and custom-parser migration
selected_topics.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: Windows Event Log -> Agent native XML -> Collector WinOSXmlParser -> normalized attributes -> rules
selected_topics.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: update custom parser before agent upgrade; send XML; parse on Collector; deploy content update to all receiving Collectors
selected_topics.failure_class: raw events arrive but custom fields disappear after XML schema transition
selected_topics.evidence_pattern: raw XML plus WinOSXmlParser output and expected event attributes; compare agent/content versions
selected_topics.remediation_path: upgrade custom parsers first; deploy to every Collector; verify Content Update 606 where applicable
selected_topics.question_fingerprint: parser work shift and XML schema migration sequence
selected_topics.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: Windows Event Log -> Agent XML -> Collector parser -> normalized event -> analytics

selected_topics.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: create shared/per-IP profile; create top-down matching policy; classify traffic type/user/service/app/URL; apply directional profile

selected_topics.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: enable load-balance; choose in/out/bi bandwidth hash; set underlay measurement; map overlays to physical WANs; validate service members
selected_topics.failure_class: multiple overlays sharing one circuit are treated as independent capacity and overload the same WAN
selected_topics.evidence_pattern: diagnose sys sdwan service4 shows mode, eligible members and bandwidth values
selected_topics.remediation_path: configure bandwidth-type underlay; validate member mapping, SLA eligibility and upstream/downstream bandwidth estimates
selected_topics.question_fingerprint: underlay versus overlay measurement and bidirectional selection
selected_topics.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: physical WANs -> shared underlays -> IPsec overlays -> load-balance service -> selected member
